about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Indian Masala Omelette Roll with Green Chilli
recipes.summary: A fluffy omelette packed with onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander, rolled up for a quick Indian breakfast.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, turmeric and salt.
Melt half the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in half the mixture and cook for 3 minutes, until the underside is golden and the top is almost set.
Roll up and slide onto a plate, then repeat with the rest.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelette until the egg is fully set with no runny egg.
Serve with buttered toast or paratha.

recipes.title: Greek Spanakopita Breakfast Scramble
recipes.summary: Soft scrambled eggs with wilted spinach, feta and dill, finished with lemon and served on toast.
steps: Wilt the spinach and spring onion in the oil for 2 minutes, until soft, then press out the water.
Beat the eggs and pour into the pan.
Stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set and creamy.
Fold in the feta, dill and lemon juice.
Toast the sourdough until golden and pile the eggs on top.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Italian Frittata with Zucchini and Ricotta
recipes.summary: A light baked frittata of zucchini, spring onion and mint, studded with ricotta.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C and grease a 20cm ovenproof dish.
Squeeze the zucchini dry and cook with the spring onion in the oil for 4 minutes, until soft.
Whisk the eggs with the mint, salt and pepper and pour over.
Dot the ricotta over and bake for 14 minutes, until puffed and just set in the centre.
Rest for 3 minutes, then slice.
notes: Great cold in lunchboxes.
Food safety: bake until the centre is set and no longer liquid. Wash fresh produce well, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat them within 3 days.

recipes.title: German Bauernfruhstuck Farmer's Breakfast
recipes.summary: Crispy fried potatoes with bacon, onion and eggs, a hearty German breakfast cooked in one pan.
steps: Fry the bacon in the butter for 5 minutes, until crisp.
Add the potatoes and fry for 10 minutes, turning rarely, until golden and crunchy.
Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes, until soft.
Beat the eggs and pour over, then cook for 4 minutes, stirring gently, until set.
Scatter with chives and pepper.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and piping hot, and the eggs until fully set.
Cook the potatoes ahead for crisp results.

recipes.title: Ricotta Hotcakes with Lemon and Warm Apple Compote
recipes.summary: Light, tender ricotta hotcakes served with warm blueberry compote and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Whisk the ricotta, egg yolks, milk and lemon zest together.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and sugar.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks and gently fold them in.
Melt a little butter in a pan and cook 1/4 cup scoops for 2 minutes each side, until puffed and golden.
Simmer the apple, honey and lemon juice in a small pan for 6 minutes, until soft and syrupy, and spoon over.
notes: Food safety: cook the hotcakes until the batter is set in the middle.
Add a pinch of cinnamon to the compote.

recipes.title: Scandinavian Smorrebrod Smoked Salmon and Dill Rye
recipes.summary: Open rye sandwiches with dill cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber and capers.
steps: Beat the cream cheese with the dill and lemon juice until smooth.
Spread thickly over the rye slices.
Layer on the cucumber and fold the smoked salmon on top.
Scatter with the capers, onion and pepper and serve straight away.
notes: Food safety: keep smoked salmon chilled and avoid it in pregnancy or when serving anyone vulnerable.
Add boiled egg slices for more protein.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Banh Mi Omelette Baguette
recipes.summary: Egg omelette in a crisp baguette with pickled carrot, cucumber, coriander and chilli mayonnaise.
steps: Toss the carrot with the vinegar and sugar and leave for 10 minutes, until lightly pickled.
Whisk the eggs with the fish sauce.
Cook in the butter in a pan for 3 minutes, until set, then fold and halve.
Mix the mayonnaise and sriracha and spread inside the warmed baguettes.
Fill with the omelette, pickled carrot, cucumber and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set with no runny egg.
Add pate for a classic version.

recipes.title: Korean Gyeran Ppang Egg Bread
recipes.summary: Fluffy Korean street-food muffins baked with a whole egg in the middle, sweet and savoury at once.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 4-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then add the milk, butter and 1 egg to make a thick batter.
Fill the holes half full, then crack an egg into the middle of each.
Bake for 18 minutes, until the batter is golden and the egg whites are set.
Sprinkle with parsley and eat warm.
notes: Food safety: bake until the whites are fully set, and until the yolk is set if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Chinese Jianbing Crepe with Egg and Crackers
recipes.summary: A Tianjin street crepe with egg, hoisin and chilli sauce wrapped around crispy wonton wrappers.
steps: Whisk the flours and water into a thin batter.
Heat a nonstick pan with a little oil and pour in half the batter, swirling thin.
Cook for 1 minute, then crack an egg on top, spread it and scatter with sesame and spring onion.
Cook for 2 minutes, until the egg is set, then flip.
Spread with the hoisin and chilli sauces, add the coriander and fried wonton wrapper, and fold up.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set.
Repeat for the second crepe.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Hausa Koko Millet Porridge
recipes.summary: A peppery, ginger-spiced millet porridge sweetened with sugar and served with milk.
steps: Whisk the millet flour with 200ml cold water into a paste.
Bring the remaining water, ginger, cloves and pepper to a rolling boil, until fragrant.
Whisk in the paste and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring, until thick and smooth.
Stir in the sugar and salt and serve with the milk.
notes: Add groundnut paste for extra richness.
Strain through a sieve for a very smooth porridge.

recipes.title: South African Mealie Pap with Tomato Relish
recipes.summary: Soft white maize porridge served with a warm tomato and onion relish, a South African staple.
steps: Bring the water and salt to a rolling boil, then slowly whisk in the cornmeal until no lumps remain.
Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick and cooked.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes, curry powder, sugar and chilli and cook for 8 minutes, until pulpy.
Stir the butter into the pap and serve with the warm relish.
notes: Add more water for a runny porridge.

recipes.title: Caribbean Cornmeal Porridge with Nutmeg and Cinnamon
recipes.summary: Smooth Jamaican-style cornmeal porridge flavoured with cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla and sweetened with condensed milk.
steps: Whisk the cornmeal with 250ml cold water into a paste.
Bring the remaining water and cinnamon to a rolling boil, until the water smells spiced.
Whisk in the paste and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring, until thick and smooth.
Remove the cinnamon, add the nutmeg, vanilla, salt, milk and condensed milk and warm for 2 minutes.
notes: Stir often to avoid lumps.
Add extra condensed milk to taste.

recipes.title: Caribbean Cornmeal Johnnycakes
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried cornmeal and flour cakes with a crisp edge and soft centre, great with butter and fried fish or eggs.
steps: Whisk the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt together.
Rub in the butter until it resembles crumbs, then add the milk to make a soft dough.
Knead briefly, then shape into 8 flat discs.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through.
notes: Serve warm.
Store cooled cakes in a sealed container for 2 days.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Genfo Barley Porridge with Spiced Butter
recipes.summary: A thick barley flour porridge with a well of spiced butter and berbere-style paprika sauce in the centre.
steps: Bring the water and salt to a rolling boil, until bubbling hard.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 12 minutes, stirring hard with a wooden spoon, until the porridge is thick and smooth.
Melt the butter with the paprika, cardamom, ginger and chilli for 2 minutes, until sizzling.
Shape the porridge into bowls, make a well and fill with the spiced butter.
Serve with the yoghurt alongside and eat while hot.
notes: Eat by scooping the porridge into the butter.
Use oat flour if barley flour is hard to find.

recipes.title: Peruvian Quinoa Breakfast Porridge with Cinnamon
recipes.summary: Warm quinoa cooked in milk with cinnamon, cloves and apple, sweetened with honey.
steps: Simmer the quinoa, milk, cinnamon, cloves and salt for 18 minutes, stirring often, until the grains are tender and the porridge thick.
Add the apple and honey and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove the cinnamon and cloves.
Serve with the toasted almonds scattered over the top.
notes: Use almond milk for a no-dairy bowl.

recipes.title: French Gougeres Cheese Puffs
recipes.summary: Light choux pastry puffs flavoured with vegetarian hard cheese, mustard and nutmeg, best eaten warm.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line two trays with baking paper.
Bring the water, milk, butter and salt to the boil, then tip in the flour and stir for 2 minutes, until a smooth ball forms.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the cheese, mustard and nutmeg, until glossy.
Pipe or spoon walnut-sized mounds onto the trays.
Bake for 25 minutes, until puffed and deep golden.
notes: Food safety: bake until deep golden and cooked through, as the dough contains raw egg.
Do not open the oven in the first 15 minutes, or they collapse.
